- B6-1: vendor_c is added through the existing vendor mapping registry, not a separate ad hoc parser. (fact: Vendor column mappings live in one registry module so new vendors are added there, not parsed ad hoc.)

+def vendor_c_timestamp(value):
+    """Normalize an ISO-8601 timestamp with an explicit offset to UTC."""
+    timestamp = datetime.fromisoformat(value.strip().replace("Z", "+00:00"))
+    if timestamp.tzinfo is None:
+        raise ValueError(f"missing UTC offset in vendor_c timestamp: {value!r}")
+    return timestamp.astimezone(timezone.utc).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")
